user.title: Huawei Home Storage
user.description: Choose how to sign in. Either way, the device IP, MAC, serial number and model are fetched from the cloud automatically.

account.title: Sign in to Huawei Account
account.description: Enter your Huawei account and password. Credentials are stored only in your Home Assistant instance and are used to discover the device.

authorize.title: Authorize Huawei Account

retry.title: Huawei Home Storage
retry.description: Could not reach Huawei Cloud. Check Home Assistant's network and press Submit to retry.

device.title: Select device
device.description: Choose the Home Storage device to add from your account.

menu.title: Account management
menu.description: {accounts} account(s) connected: {list}. Device attributes (disk, online, file space) come from the admin account; album stats differ per account.

add_account.title: Add Huawei account
add_account.description: Enter the Huawei account to connect to this storage. Each account sees its own albums and files.

remove_account.title: Remove account
remove_account.description: Pick an account to remove (at least one is kept). Its album entities are removed too.

relogin.title: Re-login account
relogin.description: Update credentials for an expired account without affecting others.

challenge_channel.title: Choose verification method
challenge_channel.description: This Huawei account needs a verification code. Choose how to receive it: **SMS** sends the code to the phone bound to the account; **Signed-in device** requires you to read it on a Huawei device already signed in to this account.

acct_challenge_channel.title: Choose verification method
acct_challenge_channel.description: This Huawei account needs a verification code. Choose how to receive it: **SMS** sends the code to the phone bound to the account; **Signed-in device** requires you to read it on a Huawei device already signed in to this account.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Huawei Cloud, check your network and retry.
error.invalid_challenge: Incorrect or expired verification code, please retry.
error.authorization_pending: Authorization not detected yet. Confirm in the browser, then submit again.
error.code_expired: The verification code expired. A new one has been generated, please authorize again.
error.no_device: No Home Storage device found in this account.
error.code_dispatch_failed: Could not send the verification code. Try again or pick another method.

abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Huawei Cloud or obtain device credentials.
abort.no_device: No Home Storage device found in this account.
abort.already_configured: This device is already configured for this Huawei account. To access the same device with another account, add it again with that account.
abort.smarthome_unavailable: Account login module unavailable; use device-code authorization instead.
abort.cannot_remove_last: At least one account must remain.

options.account: Huawei account + password (no browser hop, recommended)
options.device_code: Device code (confirm once in a browser, HA never sees the password)

create_folder.name: Create folder
create_folder.description: Create folder(s) in the file space (path for one, paths for many; duplicate names fail instead of being renamed).

paths.name: Folder paths (batch)
paths.description: The device batch endpoint is not solved; folders are created one by one.

rename_path.name: Rename path
rename_path.description: Rename a file or folder (trailing slash for folders, none for files).

new_path.name: New path
new_path.description: New path in the same parent folder.

file_id.name: Entry id
file_id.description: Leave empty to resolve it by listing the parent folder.

move_paths.name: Move files/folders
move_paths.description: Move files or folders into a destination folder (async task).

copy_paths.name: Copy files/folders
copy_paths.description: Copy files or folders into a destination folder (async task; destination must exist).

delete_paths.name: Delete files/folders
delete_paths.description: Delete files or folders from the file space — always moved to the recycle bin (recoverable).

upload_file.name: Upload file
upload_file.description: Upload text or a file from the HA host into the device file space.

local_path.name: Local file path
local_path.description: Path on the HA host (commonly readable under /config).

cancel_upload.name: Cancel upload
cancel_upload.description: Cancel an in-progress upload (needs the fileId from prepareUpload).

copy_to_album.name: Copy to album
copy_to_album.description: Copy photos from the file space into an album (async task).

paths.name: Source file paths
paths.description: Photo paths in the file space.

album_name.name: Album name
album_name.description: Optional, sent along with the request.

fids.name: Source fids
fids.description: One per path; resolved automatically when omitted.

file_detail.name: File detail
file_detail.description: Query file/folder details (device parameters not fully solved, may return empty).

photo_info.name: Photo metadata
photo_info.description: Resolve album photo fileIds into full metadata (including the hdcFilePath original).

search_files.name: Search files
search_files.description: Search the file space by keyword (parameters found by exhaustive probing: query + limit/offset).

list_recycle.name: List recycle bin
list_recycle.description: List recycle bin entries (their rid is used by recover_recycle).

recover_recycle.name: Recover from recycle bin
recover_recycle.description: Restore an entry from the recycle bin (pass rid, or paths/names to match automatically).

delete_media.name: Move media to trash
delete_media.description: Move photos/videos to the recycle bin (recoverable).

recover_media.name: Recover media
recover_media.description: Restore photos/videos from the recycle bin.

task_status.name: Query transfer tasks
task_status.description: Query the task center: filesvc = file-space tasks, trans = cross-service transfers.

task_types.name: Task types
task_types.description: Defaults to the captured full ranges (filesvc→400..408).

duplicate_scan.name: Duplicate photo scan
duplicate_scan.description: Start or stop duplicate photo scan (never deletes photos).

reboot_device.name: Reboot storage device
reboot_device.description: ⚠️ Interrupts storage service for 1-2 minutes (recoverable); the integration never reboots automatically.

disk_sleep.name: Disk sleep
disk_sleep.description: Put device disks to sleep (recoverable; wake-up follows device policy).

usb_plug_out.name: Eject USB device
usb_plug_out.description: ⚠️ Eject USB storage from the device (recoverable, but in-flight file I/O is interrupted).

refresh_credentials.name: Refresh device credentials
refresh_credentials.description: Request a new device session from Huawei Cloud (use when the device returns 401 or credentials expire).

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Leave empty to target the first configured device.

clean_task_records.name: Clean task records
clean_task_records.description: Clear history entries in the task center (display only; no files are touched).

add_to_album.name: Add to album
add_to_album.description: Add existing photos to an album (gallery fileIds, not file-space fids; adding twice is idempotent).

get_task.name: Get single task
get_task.description: Look up one task by its taskId (complements the bulk task_status query).

album_info.name: Album detail
album_info.description: Metadata and cover image paths for one album (fallback when the album list has no cover).

album_changes.name: Album changes
album_changes.description: Album increment table: which albums changed (read-only).

share_to_person.name: Share to person
share_to_person.description: Share photos to a person album (ownerId is a device user id).

file_names.name: File names
file_names.description: One per file_id; may be omitted.
